name: io.github.comficker/pixel-art-mcp
description: Turn images into pixel art, extract and remap palettes, and upscale sprites without blur.

tools.name: pixelate_image
tools.description: Turn a photo or illustration into pixel art: shrink it to a pixel grid and reduce it to a few colours (or a named palette). Returns the PNG.

image_url.description: Public http(s) URL of a PNG or JPEG (max 4 MB, 2048x2048)

image_base64.description: PNG or JPEG as base64 (or a data: URL), if there is no public URL

width.description: Width of the pixel grid in pixels (height keeps the aspect ratio)

colors.description: Number of colours when no palette is given

palette.description: Palette id (e.g. pico-8, game-boy-dmg, cga-16, sweetie-16; see list_palettes) or hex colours like "#1a1c2c,#5d275d"

scale.description: Nearest-neighbour upscale of the returned PNG, capped at 1024 px

tools.name: extract_palette
tools.description: Pull the main colours out of an image (median cut). Returns hex codes plus a GIMP/Aseprite .gpl palette.

image_url.description: Public http(s) URL of a PNG or JPEG (max 4 MB, 2048x2048)

image_base64.description: PNG or JPEG as base64 (or a data: URL), if there is no public URL

tools.name: remap_palette
tools.description: Recolour an existing pixel art image so every pixel uses a colour from the given palette (e.g. PICO-8 or Game Boy). Size is kept. Returns the PNG.

image_url.description: Public http(s) URL of a PNG or JPEG (max 4 MB, 2048x2048)

image_base64.description: PNG or JPEG as base64 (or a data: URL), if there is no public URL

palette.description: Palette id (e.g. pico-8, game-boy-dmg, cga-16, sweetie-16; see list_palettes) or hex colours like "#1a1c2c,#5d275d"

tools.name: upscale_pixel_art
tools.description: Scale pixel art up by a whole number with nearest neighbour, so pixels stay sharp. Output is capped at 1024 px.

image_url.description: Public http(s) URL of a PNG or JPEG (max 4 MB, 2048x2048)

image_base64.description: PNG or JPEG as base64 (or a data: URL), if there is no public URL

tools.name: list_palettes
tools.description: List the built-in pixel art palettes with their ids and colour counts.

tools.name: get_palette
tools.description: The colours of a built-in palette (e.g. pico-8, game-boy-dmg, cga-16, ega-64), as hex codes or a GIMP/Aseprite .gpl file.

format.description: hex: one line of #RRGGBB codes; gpl: a GIMP/Aseprite palette file

tools.name: search_palettes
tools.description: Find built-in palettes by name and/or exact number of colours.

query.description: Part of a name or id, e.g. "game boy" or "cga"

colors.description: Only palettes with exactly this many colours
